Riley (People Ops): FYI we have a quota-carryover rep asking whether they can do after-tax contributions and then convert in-plan to Roth mid-year. any operational blockers?
Sam (Payroll): plan doc first. if vendor allows in-service conversions we're OK, but payroll needs a stable deduction code. will need a unique code so conversions don't grab pre-tax by mistake.
Priya (Finance): watch nondiscrimination testing. after-tax still counts in ADP/ACP tests until distribution. high after-tax from a few sales reps could skew results.
Taylor (Sales): what about commissions paid quarterly? if i make an after-tax election will the quarterly commission be eligible for conversion right away?
Sam (Payroll): conversion inclusion depends on vendor batch timing. if commission posts after payroll cut and conversion already ran, it will be in next cycle. recommend noting expected run cadence in FAQ.
Payroll Bot: ticket #PR-8420 created to add deduction code ATX_SALES and conversion flag ATX_RCONV.
Riley (People Ops): action: Sam to add payroll codes; Priya to run a hypothetical ADP test; Sam to confirm vendor cadence and termination handling. I'll update the benefits FAQ with the caveats.
Sam (Payroll): noted, will update once TPA confirms.
Taylor (Sales): thanks, that's helpful. will wait for FAQ before enrolling.
